order_description: Respiratory assist device, bi-level pressure capability, with back-up rate feature, used with noninvasive interface, e.g., nasal or facial mask (intermittent assist device with continuous positive airway pressure device)

candidates.title: Positive Airway Pressure (PAP) Devices for the Treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea
Hypoglossal Nerve Stimulation for the Treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea

selection_reason: The order is for E0471, a bi-level device with back-up rate. The patient's condition is severe obstructive sleep apnea (AHI 32, central/mixed apneas 8%), not hypoventilation, CSA/CompSA, restrictive thoracic disorder, or COPD-related chronic respiratory failure, so L33800's E0471 criteria do not apply. L33718 states that an E0471 billed with a primary diagnosis of OSA is not reasonable and necessary and will be denied. L38310 governs hypoglossal nerve stimulator implantation, not E0471 coverage, so it does not cover this order.
decision_explanation: None of the retrieved policies covers this order.
